headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: A Panama-flagged tanker, the On Peace, was hit by an unknown projectile in Hormuz, wounding 12 crew; no one claimed it. Qatar says US–Iran messages are still moving through Doha. Trump says the US must finish with Iran "the nice way or the not-so-nice way." Houthis claimed strikes on Riyadh's airport and the Rabigh refinery; the East-West line is moving oil to Yanbu. Brent dipped below $100.
change_note: Oct. 7: Escalated war now means a step the war hasn't taken yet: ground forces in Iran, strikes on Iranian civilian infrastructure, or a major Gulf export hub, power or desalination plant knocked out for a week. Another July-style strike campaign counts as limited war. Escalated by Nov. 3: 14% → 7%; by year-end: 20% → 12%. Vance says Iran must make a "meaningful" cut in enrichment capacity: year-end deal 15% → 13%, MOU-style by Nov. 3 11% → 10%. War by Nov. 3 60% → 45% under the stricter rule (an official claim of a specific, confirmed attack, or a US strike). Blink #10 re-derived: 70% blink, 30% no blink. Price ranges recentred on the futures: gas ≥ $4.50 on Nov. 3 37% → 13%, Brent (Jan.) ≥ $100 65% → 37%.

bets.cond: The IRGC or Artesh officially claims a specific attack that is independently confirmed
bets.effect: War by Nov. 3 resolves yes; escalated ~{nov3:escalated_war}%

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
The East-West line or Yanbu is offline 3+ days
